patches_modified.name: Skip ads (v17)
patches_modified.description: Removes the ads, ad markers, and pause ads from on-demand videos on Pluto TV v17. Live TV ads are part of the broadcast and are not removed. Hook design ported from semicoloncolonel's tv-morphe-patches.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes Pluto TV's on-demand (VOD) ads on the v17.x rebuild (the Paramount+/AVIA player stack). Four layers: (1+2) force AVIA's DAI and IMA shouldPlayAd() gates to false so the pre-roll ad pods are skipped natively; (3) drop the ad <Period>s from the stitched multi-period DASH manifest at AVIA's own DashParser and re-base the content periods into a contiguous timeline, so the mid-roll ad VIDEO is never played AND the seekbar tracks correctly; (4) suppress the ID3/CLID3-driven CSAI ad call on static VOD manifests. Also hides pause ads and stops ad impression beacons for the removed breaks. Fail-open: a manifest it can't rewrite is passed through unchanged (ads remain, playback never breaks). LIVE TV ads are real broadcast time in the linear feed and are not removable. Validated on-device, 17.2.0.

The server is started again every few seconds and nothing of what it says is reachable otherwise: its logger is built at a level that drops every message, and its output is sent to /dev/null. Use this to find out why it ends, not as a fix.

patches_removed.name: Input without the ADB server
patches_removed.description: Keeps key, pointer and gamepad input working when the "ADB speed up" server is not running. The app only asks whether speed-up is enabled, not whether the server it starts as the shell user on localhost:15000 is up, and it drops the request without falling back when the port is closed - so numpad keys and mouse input do nothing. Each of those requests is now gated on the app's own port probe, and the injection site's ordinary path runs while no server is listening.

patches_removed.name: Never stop itself
patches_removed.description: Keeps the app from stopping its own package. Stop recent apps, Restart app and Force stop app all end in `am force-stop <package>` run over ADB, and the app is in the recents list it works from, so once an ADB connection is up the app stops itself, restarts, and loops every few seconds. The app only skips the foreground app, and only when the matching preference is enabled, so this covers what the preference does not. Custom ADB command actions are covered too, and such a command is logged under the TVQA-GUARD tag before it is dropped.

patches_removed.name: Unlock native engine
patches_removed.description: Patches the native engine libraries so that they run on a re-signed APK. The anti-tamper constructor of libd.so that destroys a global mutex is disabled, and the trap instructions the verification routine plants inside its own code - udf #0 (SIGILL) and stores of the markers 0xdead and 0xdeadbeef (SIGSEGV) - are replaced by no-ops, leaving the routine's work intact. This is what makes Web Widget Overlay and button emulation work. The server-only liba.so self-stop calls are also disabled for ARM32 and ARM64 so ADB speed-up does not terminate the app.

patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the modern home UI. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and earlier, and 2026.40.0 and later.

patches_modified.name: Disable post detail swipe
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to stop swiping sideways in a post from opening the next or previous post.

patches_modified.name: Disable refresh on back to exit
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to exit the app with back on the home feed without first scrolling to the top and reloading. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Disable screenshot popup
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to disable the popup that appears when taking a screenshot.

patches_modified.name: Download all from gallery
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to download every item of a gallery post with the Download button of the share sheet. This patch works with Reddit 2026.44.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Download location
patches_modified.description: Adds options to choose the folder and file name of downloaded images and videos, which can use the subreddit, author and account, and can be set per account.

patches_modified.name: Enable debugging
patches_modified.description: Adds options for exporting Morphe logs and for blocking or forcing Reddit experiments.

patches_modified.name: Feed auto-scroll
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to slowly scroll the feed on screen automatically.

patches_modified.name: Feed media max height
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to change the maximum height of images, videos and galleries in the feed.

patches_modified.name: Flair filters
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide feed posts with a flair of a community.

patches_modified.name: Force system font
patches_modified.description: Adds an option that renders Reddit with the device system font instead of Reddit Sans / Roboto.

patches_modified.name: Full width feed media
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show images and videos edge to edge in the feed and post details, without side padding and rounded corners.

patches_modified.name: Full-screen reply
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to write replies in the older full-screen editor, which shows the comment you are replying to. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Glass navigation bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show the bottom navigation bar, or the side rail on tablets, as a floating translucent capsule. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Hide Answers preview
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Reddit Answers preview at the top of search results.

patches_modified.name: Hide Ask button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide Ask button in the search bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide People also search for section
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the 'People also search for' section from search results.

patches_modified.name: Hide Reddit search
patches_modified.description: Permanently hides the Reddit search in the contextual menu. This patch does not work with root mounting

patches_modified.name: Hide Related Posts section
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the 'Related Posts' section below the comments of a post.

patches_modified.name: Hide Trending shelves
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Trending shelves from feed and search suggestions.

patches_modified.name: Hide Videos for you shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the 'Videos for you' shelf in the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.40.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Hide ads
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide ads.

patches_modified.name: Hide comment flairs and badges
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide user flairs and community badges next to the authors of comments.

patches_modified.name: Hide communities shelf
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the related or suggested communities shelf in subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide community highlights
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the Community highlights section at the top of subreddits.

patches_modified.name: Hide community menu badge
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the red dot on the community menu button.

patches_modified.name: Hide home tabs
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the For You, Following and Popular tabs of the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.40.0 and later.

patches_modified.name: Hide interactive posts
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide game and other interactive app posts from the home feed and other recommended feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide media viewer components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the "See the conversation" button and the title, buttons and video controls of the media viewer. Hiding the title, buttons and video controls requires Reddit 2026.38.0 or newer.

patches_modified.name: Hide navigation buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide buttons in the navigation bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide post buttons
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the buttons of posts in the feeds, the post detail screen and the media viewer, such as the Join, vote, comment, award, repost and share buttons. Hiding the buttons below posts works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Hide sidebar components
patches_modified.description: Adds options to hide the sidebar components.

patches_modified.name: High quality avatars
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show user avatars in full resolution instead of the low resolution version.

patches_modified.name: Home feed tabs
patches_modified.description: Adds options to show the For You, Following and Popular tabs on the home feed, and to switch them by swiping or only by tapping. This patch works with Reddit 2026.43.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Keep feed position
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to keep the feed at the same position after closing a post, image or video, instead of moving the opened post to the top of the screen.

patches_modified.name: Keep media viewer in subreddit
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show only posts from the same subreddit when swiping through the full screen media viewer.

patches_modified.name: Keyword filters
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide feed posts with a title or text that matches a regular expression.

patches_modified.name: Media viewer black background
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to use a black background behind images and videos in the media viewer, instead of the theme background color.

patches_modified.name: Media viewer fade
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to lower or remove the dark fade behind the caption when viewing images and videos.

patches_modified.name: Open links directly
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to skip over redirection URLs in external links.

patches_modified.name: Open links externally
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open links in your browser instead of with the in-app-browser.

patches_modified.name: Open system share sheet
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to always open the system share sheet instead of the in-app share sheet. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Post side panel
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to open posts in a panel next to the feed on wide tablet screens.

patches_modified.name: Private browsing mode
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to choose whether private browsing uses Anonymous Browsing or Incognito. This patch works with Reddit 2026.43.0 to 2026.47.0.
patches_modified.previous_description: Adds an option to choose whether private browsing uses Anonymous Browsing or Incognito. This patch works with Reddit 2026.43.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Redgifs audio
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to play the original Redgifs video, which has audio, instead of Reddit's silent copy.

patches_modified.name: Remember collapsed comments
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to keep comments you collapsed collapsed when reopening a post.

patches_modified.name: Remove subreddit dialog
patches_modified.description: Adds options to remove the NSFW community warning and notifications suggestion dialogs by dismissing them automatically.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to sanitize sharing links by removing tracking query parameters.

patches_modified.name: Search hidden profiles
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to make the profile search find the posts of profiles that hide their posts or comments.

patches_modified.name: See-through status bar
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to let the home feed scroll up under the status bar and fade into it. This patch works with Reddit 2026.43.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Share post content
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to share the image, video or text of a post instead of its link when using app shortcuts or "Share via…" in the share sheet.

patches_modified.name: Show flairs in home feed
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show post flair badges in the home feed. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Spoofs the signature of the app to fix notification issues.

patches_modified.name: Start as guest
patches_modified.description: Skips the forced startup login screen using Reddit's native guest browsing mode.

patches_modified.name: Swipe up for comments
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to open the comments by swiping up in the media viewer, and to swipe sideways for the next post. This patch works with Reddit 2026.24.0 and newer.

patches_modified.name: Tablet grid feed
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show feeds as a grid with 2 or 3 columns on tablets.

patches_modified.name: Video playback speed
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to show Reddit's playback speed controls in the full-screen video player. This patch works with Reddit 2026.40.0 and newer.
